text: Three boxes are mislabeled Apples, Oranges and Mixed. How many fruits must you draw to relabel all correctly?
explanation: Draw one fruit from the box labelled Mixed: since every label is wrong, it holds a single fruit, which fixes the other two by elimination.

subject: reasoning
text: Explain why modus tollens is valid.
explanation: If P implies Q and Q is false, then P must be false, because Q true whenever P true.
objective: If P implies Q and Q is false, then P must be false, because Q true whenever P true.
